# Surface matrix

Every user-facing route, what owns its data, and what it owes the user with the radio off. This is the scope of the offline program (#486): a route added without a row fails `npm run check:surfaces`, and so does a `precached` claim on a page that cannot be prerendered.

`shell` describes the remote document; `bundle` describes the Android app, where a bundled SPA routes client-side and so handles dynamic segments the remote precache cannot.
